messages:
Tyler (Sales): FYI team — AcmeGov greenlit the POC start for next Tue but procurement won't sign until we clear two items: (A) HSM/KMS attestation in the DPA, (B) flexible invoice cadence for the 6mo reserved commit. They want countersign routed to procurement + legal.
Jen (Legal): ok. can you upload the PO they sent? want to see if there are any unusual indemnities or audit clauses.
Tyler (Sales): uploaded in portal, pasted summary below:

```
PO#: AG-PO-2026-443
Total: $48,000 (6-month reserved-Dedicated)
Instance: dedicated-8xA100
Billing: quarterly invoicing requested
Security: require vendor-signed HSM attestation; DPA redline requested
```

Kai (Solutions): quick note — if this runs in Dedicated we can offer BYO-KMS with HSM-backed keys. If Hosted they'd expect vendor-managed keys; that'll affect the attestation wording.
Alex (Security): adding: we can provide SOC2 excerpts + KMS architecture diagram and a vendor attestation template. For a signed attestation, Legal will need a short addendum we can sign and stamp.
Jen (Legal): I'll prepare a DPA redline and a one-page HSM attestation addendum. Question: do we have a standard vendor-signed attestation, or will Security sign a custom letter?
Alex (Security): we have a standard attestation pdf (certified by our infra team). I'll attach after this thread.
Elaine (Finance): quarterly billing ok pending approval. need the actual signed PO pdf and confirmation whether billing starts at term start or at resource consumption. if they want start-of-term invoicing deferred, that's a billing credit discussion.
Tyler (Sales): asked procurement: they prefer DocuSign; two signers (procurement + legal). requested countersign within 5 business days.
redwood-bot: infra-note: dedicated-8xA100 (us-west-2) current spare capacity 12% across canary pool.
Kai (Solutions): Proposal: include a 1-page "POC BOM" showing GPU hours, reserved vs burst hours, monitoring/observability credits, escalation contact and short SLA bullets (p90 latency, uptime target, fallback to smaller model). That usually smooths procurement reviews.
Jen (Legal): agreed. Action items: 1) Jen will push DPA redline + HSM addendum by EOD. 2) Alex to post attestation + SOC2 excerpt. 3) Elaine to approve quarterly invoices after PO pdf + billing cadence confirmed. 4) Kai to draft one-page POC BOM + SLA snippet. 5) Tyler to confirm DocuSign flow and signer emails.
Tyler (Sales): noting action items — I'll follow up with procurement and post the signed PO link here. please ping me when drafts are ready. :thumbsup:
Alex (Security): will post attestation doc in follow-up message.
Elaine (Finance): will start a billing ticket once PO pdf is attached.
Kai (Solutions): will share draft POC BOM tomorrow morning.
Jen (Legal): closing loop for now — will @channel when DPA redline is uploaded.
